audit: 2026-09-20 scheduled remote agent, second fire of the day (batch b): one 50 question batch across all four modules, published as data/batches/sched_multi_topic_2026-09-20_b_01.json through b_16.json, split into sixteen small files purely for reliable transfer through the GitHub MCP. Split 13 Paediatrics, 13 Obstetrics and Gynaecology, 12 Psychiatry and 12 Medicine; tier mix 36 L3 and 14 L4 with no L1, no L2 and no L5, taking the bank to 7122 with the modules at 1781/1781/1780/1780, a spread of one. CELL SELECTION: this fire independently re-derived and then confirmed the convention of the three preceding fires, measuring each tier against the achievable L3 to L5 stock rather than the whole topic denominator. Both readings were simulated in full before choosing. Under the literal whole topic denominator every L3 and L4 cell shows a double digit deficit that the 353 to 422 permanently closed legacy L2 questions per module make unclosable, and a strict simulation allocated all 50 questions to L3 and none to L4 or L5, because L3 leads L4 by a fixed 1.3 points that adding L3 questions only widens. On the achievable denominator the opening shares were Paediatrics 49.17/44.20/6.63, Obstetrics 49.22/44.23/6.55, Psychiatry 49.32/44.34/6.33 and Medicine 49.27/44.24/6.49. The second simulation bug recorded by the previous fire was avoided: module totals were updated as questions were notionally added during the near tie break, which prevents the whole batch collapsing into the single smallest module. Final achievable shares are Paediatrics 49.44/44.00/6.56, Obstetrics 49.48/44.03/6.49, Psychiatry 49.47/44.25/6.28 and Medicine 49.42/44.15/6.43: L3 improved in all four modules and the L5 surplus fell in all four. L5 was generated zero times because it is in surplus on the achievable denominator and sits at or just above target on the whole bank denominator. DUPLICATE CONTROL, fifth consecutive confirmation of the gate weakness: scripts/dupe_gate.py passed the first assembled batch of 50 cleanly with 0 of 50 duplicates, but the separate answer axis screen recommended by four prior fires flagged 21 of those 50, of which 14 were judged substantive repeats of an identical exam point and were withdrawn and replaced. Examples include Duchenne dystrophin testing scoring 1.000 against med-0915e-09 in an earlier draft, periocular haemangioma, eczema herpeticum at 0.591 with detail 0.53 against sched-2026-09-07-p5-003, ventilation tube referral at 0.922, adenomyosis at 0.946, acromegaly screening against three separate existing items, and hereditary angioedema at combined 0.81 with detail 0.92 against med-gap9c-002, which is above the gate's own 0.80 hard threshold yet passed because the gate also requires the detail axis to clear its floor in the same pair. A sixth replacement round was needed after one substitute, suction rectal biopsy for Hirschsprung disease, rose from a pre screen 0.574 to 0.721 once written in final wording and was found to duplicate four existing bank items; it was replaced with a vitamin K refusal item screened at 0.511 in exact final option text. That reconfirms the standing method note: pre screening must use the exact final option text, because draft wording systematically understates the score. Seven residual flags were retained after review as phrase collisions across genuinely different conditions, each sharing only a generic action phrase with detail similarity between 0.12 and 0.33: paediatric endocrinology referral for precocious puberty against the same referral for Turner growth hormone, immunoglobulin for immune thrombocytopenia against immunoglobulin for measles post exposure prophylaxis, benzylpenicillin with clindamycin for group A streptococcal puerperal sepsis against benzylpenicillin with gentamicin for listeriosis, starting quetiapine and reviewing in two weeks against starting light therapy on the same schedule, returning a buprenorphine dose against reducing prednisolone to the lowest effective dose, oral iron for restless legs against pancreatic enzyme replacement, and intravenous haem arginate against intravenous calcium gluconate. RECOMMENDATION for the maintainer, now supported by five independent fires: add an answer only rule to scripts/dupe_gate.py firing at about 0.62 regardless of subtopic_detail similarity, surfacing rather than hard failing pairs whose details are unrelated, since seven of this run's flags were legitimate retentions. Without that change the gate will keep certifying batches containing near duplicates; this run would have published fourteen of them. ENVIRONMENT NOTE, second independent confirmation: contrary to the routine prompt, git is authenticated in this container and origin/main is reachable. The MCP publish path was used anyway as instructed, but it cost sixteen separate commits and roughly 300 KB of hand retransmitted JSON, because every byte must be retyped into the tool call. Permitting git push would collapse that to one atomic three file commit.
